records.title: Measure Twice, Locate Once: Mitigating Hallucinations in LLM-based Agents for Repository-Scale Fault Localization
records.reason: The paper mitigates LLM-agent fault-localization hallucinations; its stated objective is correctness, not inference or serving efficiency.

records.title: BrickNN: Towards Brick-like Self-organizing Modular Neural Networks for Plastic and Collective AIoT Learning
records.reason: BrickNN concerns self-organizing modular neural networks and AIoT learning, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: Integrating Heterogeneous Knowledge for Enhanced Recommendation with Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper improves recommendation using heterogeneous knowledge and LLMs; the abstract does not claim an inference-efficiency method or result.

records.title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Models for State of Charge and Remaining Useful Life Estimation on a Rotary-Wing UAV Battery
records.reason: The work estimates battery state/remaining useful life for a UAV with ML/DL models, outside LLM inference scope.

records.title: Are All Tokens Necessary for Visual Place Recognition? An Empirical Study of Token Reduction for Efficient Inference
records.reason: This is token reduction for visual place recognition, not language-model inference or serving.
